name: Miso-Glazed Squash
description: Roasted squash wedges under a sticky miso and honey glaze.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the squash with the olive oil on a sheet pan.
Roast for 25 minutes, until browned at the edges.
Whisk the miso, honey and vinegar, brush it over the squash and roast 10 minutes more.
Scatter with the sesame seeds to serve.
